scope: Illustrative assumptions for a Brazilian tax-resident individual investing through Tesouro Direto. Not tax advice. Non-resident and cross-border treatment is out of scope and is not applied.

changelog.change: Custody now accrues daily and is collected at every coupon, sale and maturity (B3/Tesouro Direto wording). Renda+/Educa+ early-redemption custody follows the official holding-period tables (0.50%/0.20%/0.10% p.a. on the value sold). Custody is no longer deducted from the income-tax base by default, because that treatment is not confirmed by an official source; the alternative is reported as a sensitivity.

Income-tax and IOF holding periods are counted between the settlement dates of the purchase (D+1) and of the sale (D+0 since 13/09/2021), and B3 custody accrues from the purchase settlement (RFB Nota Cosit 144/2018, STN/B3 communication 070/2018). Renda+ and Educa+ instalments are taxed per purchase lot at the rate for each lot's age.

sources.name: Tesouro Direto - Regras e Regulamento (sections 1, 3 and 14)

Tesouro Direto - Tabela de Cobranca da Taxa de Custodia B3 sobre a venda antecipada (Educa+)
B3 - Como declarar investimentos do Tesouro Direto no IR 2026 (12/05/2026)
RFB Nota Cosit 144/2018 as published in STN/B3 communication 070/2018-VOP: holding periods counted from settlement dates

income_tax.basis: gain = gross redemption value - purchase cost attributed to that redemption (nominal BRL), withheld at source on sale, maturity, coupon or amortisation
income_tax.days_counted_from: settlement date of each purchase (D+1) to the payment date, or to the settlement date of the sale (D+0 since 13/09/2021); each purchase lot has its own holding period (RFB Nota Cosit 144/2018; td_regras section 14 for coupons)
income_tax.coupon_rule: Each coupon is taxed in full as income; the purchase cost is attributed to the final principal or sale (simplification).
income_tax.custody_deductible_note: NOT CONFIRMED by an official source. Official pages describe custody as deducted from the amount paid and income tax as levied on the income, without stating whether custody reduces the tax base. Default: not deducted (conservative). The simulator reports the alternative as a sensitivity.
income_tax.ntnb1_rule: Renda+/Educa+ instalments: each purchase lot is taxed on its own gain at the rate for its own age. Assumption (not stated officially): each instalment returns (instalment % / 100) of every lot's purchase cost.

iof.note: Regressive IOF on the gain for redemptions within 30 days (Decreto 6.306/2007 table). Applied before income tax; not applied to coupons (td_regras section 14).

custody.accrual: 0.20% p.a. on the value of the securities, provisioned daily from purchase settlement, pro rata (actual/365 assumed; the day count is not stated by the source). Applies to Tesouro Selic, IPCA and Prefixado (b3_tarifas, td_regras section 1).
custody.collection: Accrued custody is deducted from each semiannual coupon, from early-sale proceeds and from the maturity payment (b3_tarifas items 1-3).
custody.value_path_assumption: Between events the position value is modelled with the cash-flow engine along a linear yield path from the purchase rate to the exit rate, with the assumed IPCA/Selic VNA path; accrual is integrated on a quarterly grid plus event dates.
custody.selic_exemption_note: Per CPF across all institutions; fee charged only on the excess. The simulator assumes the simulated position is the investor's only Tesouro Selic holding.

renda_plus.income_rule: Each monthly payment above 6 minimum wages pays 0.10% on the excess (b3_tarifas wording; td_regras writes '0,10% p.a. sobre o excedente'). Interpretation: one-off 0.10% of the excess of each payment.
renda_plus.early_redemption_rule: Taxa sobre valor vendido (p.a.) by years from purchase to exit (td_tabela_renda). Interpretation: fee = rate for the total holding period x years held x value sold.

educa_plus.income_rule: As Renda+, with a 4 minimum-wage threshold.
educa_plus.early_redemption_rule: Taxa sobre valor vendido (p.a.) by years from purchase to exit (td_tabela_educa); same interpretation as Renda+.

custody.minimum_wage_path: Assumed to keep pace with the simulator's IPCA assumption (constant in real terms).

institution_fee_note: Most banks and brokers charge zero for Tesouro Direto; configurable.
buy_sell_spread: Observed Tesouro Direto buy and sell rates are used; the difference is a real cost of early sale and is shown separately.
